content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-explained-digital-creators-7|Digital Product]] creators face challenges establishing online stores. Many find themselves unable to collect payments for their products, limiting their potential earnings. COREMERCH offers a solution with a robust [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-2|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] built for creators looking to deploy a digital store using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-15|cloudflare]] Pages, allowing seamless crypto payment processing without reliance on conventional payment systems.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms can fail for various reasons: regional restrictions, currency fluctuations, and compliance issues. COREMERCH's infrastructure leverages decentralized solutions enabling creators to sell digital products directly. This approach ensures creators maintain control over their sales process and avoids dependency on third-party platforms, which can be unreliable or inaccessible in certain regions. By using Cloudflare Pages, you can host your site without incurring costs, while NOWPayments facilitates instant crypto transactions, providing a truly sovereign commerce experience.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, ensure you have the necessary components ready. First, create a GitHub account to host your project on GitHub Pages. Next, familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as it will provide backend logic for your store. Make sure you have a NOWPayments account set up to handle crypto transactions effortlessly. Lastly, gather your digital products, whether they are ebooks, courses, or software, so you can quickly upload them once your store is live. This preparation will streamline your deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you've established the hosting and backend logic, focus on integrating the payment and delivery systems. Start by configuring NOWPayments with your wallet address to receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies. Next, implement Google Apps Script to handle order confirmations and product deliveries, ensuring customers receive their purchases immediately after payment. Test the entire flow in a controlled environment to guarantee that everything functions as expected before going live. This testing phase is crucial for a smooth user experience.
No more reliance on traditional payment platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After thorough testing, it's time to launch your digital store. Announce the launch to your audience and prepare for your first transaction. Monitor the payment process carefully to ensure that customers can make purchases without issues. If any problems arise, troubleshoot them immediately to maintain customer trust. Once the first transactions are processed successfully, you can start scaling your marketing efforts, driving more traffic to your store and increasing sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your digital store live and functioning smoothly, focus on scaling your operations. Consider adding more products to your store to attract diverse customers. Utilize social media and digital marketing strategies to reach potential buyers. Additionally, analyze customer feedback to improve the user experience continuously. By nurturing your infrastructure and staying responsive to market demands, you can ensure your digital store thrives in the long term.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Your digital store, your rules, no subscriptions.

For creators looking to optimize their digital store setup, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for an end-to-end tested solution deployed in just 48 hours. This stack provides advanced features including SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations. For immediate access to setup resources, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for a rapid deployment taking 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, providing a more robust infrastructure deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. These platforms provide free hosting solutions, allowing you to create and maintain your online store without incurring costs.
What types of products can I sell on my digital store?

You can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, online courses, software, templates, and more. The flexibility of your store allows you to cater to different audiences and monetize your digital creations.
Is there support available after deploying my digital store?
